items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Nat Cole, Woody Herman -- remember Woody Herman and his small group?

ctx.x: Some beautiful days, man. I tell you. I really enjoyed my association with him and seeing so many artists down there; remember Nat Cole came down one time?
Yeah, Nat Cole, Woody Herman -- remember Woody Herman and his small group?
Yeah. With Shelly Manne, Ernie Royal, Milt Jackson.
